theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q k : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k) (Φ : Eucl k → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (G : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U k M θ ξ → IsOpen Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → G ⊆ M → G ⊆ Φ '' Ω → NullMeasurableSet G (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn θ G (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → ∃ ψ : Eucl k → ℝ, IntegrableOn ψ Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) ∧ ∀ (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (A : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (α : Eucl Q → Covector (Eucl Q) k), (∀ᵐ w ∂((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict (Ω ∩ Φ ⁻¹' G)), HasFDerivAt (f ∘ Φ) ((A (Φ w)).comp (fderiv ℝ Φ w)) w) → IntegrableOn (fun x => θ x * nVectorPushforward k (A x) (ξ x) (α (f x))) G (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) → ∫ x in G, θ x * nVectorPushforward k (A x) (ξ x) (α (f x)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫ w in Ω, ψ w * α (f (Φ w)) (fun b => fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w (EuclideanSpace.single b 1)) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))
